- **Two players** over copy-and-paste turn codes, with resume. Codes are found
  inside pasted messages even when the message has other text around them.
- The computer Olvana concentrates on one area at a time; an idle Blue now
  drops below 0.70 health around week 6 (was week 11–14).
- Engagement numbers (views, likes, comments, shares) follow realistic
  per-card profiles, and the grade is computed from them.
- Blue-side adjustments to keep Standard competitive.
- Illustrated field manual (PDF).

Under the hood: the game is now a structured codebase with automated tests
(rules, exact replay of two-player games, balance, headline variety, and
browser tests of the tutorial, a campaign and a two-player game), a balance
simulator and automatic builds for every platform.

Full history: see What's new on the playtest page.
